MYD13Q1-supplemental-qa.csv.scope: 2021 to as-of available composites, separate from Terra

POWER-recent-recheck.csv.scope: same representative regional point, 2026-10-25 through 2026-11-07 LST
POWER-recent-recheck.csv.role: publication-latency recheck, not forecast or overwrite

fields.product: MOD13Q1 or MYD13Q1; never omit product when comparing records
fields.composite_start_date: nominal composite start; not necessarily acquisition date
fields.selected_observation_date: selected pixel day from day-of-year; blank when unresolved/invalid
fields.ndvi_evi: dimensionless = valid raw * 0.0001; raw low-quality values remain, always apply quality_status
fields.vi_quality_raw: unsigned bitfield; decoded flags are preserved as separate columns
fields.quality_status: good_strict, marginal_review, excluded; same conservative project thresholds as frozen package
fields.source_file: path relative to data/supplemental/environment; adjacent .source.json contains provenance
fields.eto_fao56_mm_day: derived grass-reference ETo, mm/day; null unless required daily inputs exist and pass guards
fields.rain_minus_reference_eto_mm_day: P minus grass-reference ETo, mm/day, paired valid days only; not irrigation
fields.qa_flags: operational radiation guard and/or missing or invalid ETo inputs; no hidden imputations

power_original_units.GWETTOP_GWETROOT: dimensionless model wetness, not measured volumetric field water

spatial_policy: Point subsets retain native header grid; mixed land-cover context, no field-boundary claim or silent resampling
temporal_policy: Observation, processing and download dates remain distinct; no real-time or future-weather inference
collection_version: Not explicit in ORNL subset response; no claim of verified 061 subset collection
attribution: NASA MODIS Terra/Aqua via ORNL DAAC; NASA POWER; provider catalog references retain their source identity
